answer: Cross-Epoch Trajectory Audit. Each identity commits to a cipher of its next-epoch action plan; at epoch close, the plan is scored against revealed behaviour, and the score carries forward as a decaying consistency weight. An agent whose behaviour diverges sharply from its own prior trajectory—as a fresh sybil copy inevitably must—loses weight at the wharf where reputation is cleared for matching. Every clone must therefore fund, cipher, and sustain a separate long-horizon history, and the atlas of valid trajectories makes each fabricated one detectable against its neighbours.
